issues.description: Tiny extraction still requires external data/stories files, so the documented CPU demo fails from a clean checkout.
Story loading has no built-in fallback or generation path despite README claiming tiny mode is self-contained.
End-to-end test currently fails because required story data is missing from the repo.
Documented make demo and equivalent tiny commands do not work with the checked-in tree.
Checked-in demo artifacts reference source story metadata that is absent, masking non-reproducible outputs.
Validation loads vector manifests but never verifies the requested backend/model/dimensions match the extracted vectors.
Preference steering can run with a backend/config different from the vector manifest, producing invalid comparisons or crashes.
HF preference scoring asks for a numeric score but computes a good-minus-bad token logit, so the measurement does not match the prompt.
Preference scoring assumes tokenizer encodes ' good' and ' bad' to at least one token and uses only the first token without validation.
Config values are coerced but not validated, allowing invalid thresholds, empty emotion sets, negative token starts, and zero story counts.
steering.min_reported_emotions is configured but not implemented anywhere.
Steered emotion count is hard-coded to four instead of honoring the configured minimum.
PCA threshold 0 still returns one component, which contradicts the meaning of explaining at least 0 percent variance.
Tiny backend emotion matching uses substring counts, which can create false positives from unrelated words.
